answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 20 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. The juniper multiplier is published, charged in crystal, and nebula lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 1845 identities would post 1340 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
